findings.description: At 00:07, looking through the bedroom doorway, the corridor straight ahead and to the left is bounded by hallway walls featuring framed artwork. As the camera advances through the door at 00:08–00:09, the left hallway wall disappears and connects directly into kitchen cabinetry and appliances.

The kitchen counter layout along the left wall is altered when re-entering the space. At 00:01, the left side contains a window over a sink and a red kettle next to the stove. At 00:09, the left side wall features an over-the-range microwave mounted directly above the stove, replacing the window and sink layout shown earlier.
